title: lycopersicon pimpinellifolium var. intermedium
intro: Lycopersicon pimpinellifolium var. intermedium, commonly known as the cherry tomato, is a variant of the wild tomato plant, scientifically classified as a type of Solanum lycopersicum. This plant is rich in nutrients and has been found to have various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties. The therapeutic actions of Lycopersicon pimpinellifolium var. intermedium include its ability to protect against oxidative stress, improve cardiovascular health, and support the immune system. Its bioactive constituents include lycopene, beta-carotene, and other carotenoids, as well as various flavonoids and phenolic acids.
